title: A Well for the Choir
author: Orsen Almeida
blurb: Elodie Delacroix, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
